reuse.reason: The official file tools and attachment-local provider require Node filesystem paths and the official tool/agent runtime. Mounting or a Host-only fork cannot provide those execution contracts in Think. This minimal Think tool reads the owner Session's admitted immutable R2 objects through its Host service; official upload transport and UI remain reused by the Host/client seams.
gaps: Binary files are readable byte-for-byte but no PDF, Office or image decoding is supplied by this deployment.
